segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My objective was straightforward on paper: get this closed within our 30-day SLA without taking the gateway down during a peak sales stretch...
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant states the operational objective and constraints without a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: What really drove how I pitched it to my manager was framing what happens if we don't act... I basically built the case around what we stood to lose...
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Emergency escalation is justified primarily through avoided business losses, while the disruption cost of emergency patching is explicitly given less weight.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I spent most of my time confirming that signature was blocked correctly. The DNS spike was sitting right there in the same view... so I logged it as anomalous, monitor and moved on.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Attention is locked onto confirmation of the known exploit signature while a visible co-located DNS anomaly is only noted and not investigated.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I trust it. I built it, I know exactly how it behaves... I just didn't want to hand over something I'd already gotten working well.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The self-built script is retained as primary because of ownership, familiarity, and tuning investment despite the vendor rule's broader coverage.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd personally configured both of those controls, and I was confident the exploit path was shut down because of that setup.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Personal configuration of the controls is treated as evidence that residual exploit-path risk is fully contained.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: A news story that week about a ransomware attack... added to the sense that this needed to be wrapped up decisively rather than left open.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A recent unrelated ransomware headline is used as an additional source of urgency, outweighing ticket-specific residual-risk detail.

candidates.details: The candidate correctly localizes the attentional narrowing and offers selective attention as an alternative label. Its abstention is useful because ordinary triage and ticket scope remain plausible non-bias interpretations; when candidates are explicitly scored, it fills the cb_02 detection.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect the tool-selection and closure-urgency segments, missing escalation, anomaly triage, and control-efficacy segments; no negative segment is falsely flagged.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Including moderate-confidence findings adds the escalation and control-efficacy hits, leaving only the candidate-only anomaly segment undetected; there are no false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: No low-confidence identified findings were present, so this threshold is identical to high_and_moderate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Adding the correctly localized attentional-bias candidate detects the remaining positive segment without creating a false alarm.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 4 of 5 positive segments are detected with no false alarms (hit_rate 0.8000, F1 0.8889).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, only 1 of 5 hidden instances is an exact strict match (precision 0.2500, recall 0.2000, F1 0.2222); three additional findings have correct locations and mechanisms but near-neighbor labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, 4 of 5 hidden mechanisms are correctly localized and captured with no false positives (precision 1.0000, recall 0.8000, F1 0.8889).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The one candidate is a useful abstention: it correctly identifies the remaining selective-attention mechanism and becomes a true positive only at the fourth threshold, without adding a false alarm.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy substitutions: loss aversion for Loss Framing, familiarity heuristic for Endowment, and availability heuristic for Recency.
The selective-attention mechanism was held at candidate status, so it is absent from the first three thresholds.
Strict label performance substantially understates the quality of mechanism and localization detection.
main_strengths: All four identified findings and the candidate use valid, correctly localized interview evidence.
All matched findings capture the hidden mechanisms fully.
No findings are placed on the negative segment, and the illusion-of-control occurrence is captured with an approved equivalent label.
The candidate tier appropriately preserves uncertainty around a plausible non-bias triage interpretation.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong evidence localization and mechanism recovery but weak strict taxonomy alignment. The recommended comparison threshold is high_and_moderate; candidate inclusion improves coverage to complete mechanism-first detection for this interview, while strict label-plus-mechanism F1 remains limited by three near-neighbor labels.
